title: Sensational Spider-Man #25 First Print Marvel Comics (2006) Direct Edition
descriptionText: The product is a Sensational Spider-Man #25 first print comic book from Marvel Comics (2006). This direct edition features the characters Venom and Spider-Man (Peter Parker) in a story by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa. Part of the Marvel Universe (MCU), this US comic book from the Modern Age era showcases Spider-Man in a colorful superhero adventure. The comic is a first printing, making it a valuable collectible for fans of the superhero genre.
